name: Design System Lab tokens
description: Combines reference, semantic and component token sets with three modifiers: theme (light/dark), product (Design System Lab, the patient app, the provider workspace) and density (comfortable/compact). Read by scripts/tokens/build-tokens.mjs.

reference.description: Raw scales and palettes, identical in every permutation (no modifier may override them). Palettes are read only by semantic tokens; non-color scales may be read directly for values that must never change by theme, product or density.

semantic.description: Theme-independent roles: focus geometry, control sizing, layout rhythm, typography.

component.description: Deliberate component extension points. Each aliases a semantic role or, for values no modifier should change by default, a non-color reference scale.

theme.description: Color theme. Both contexts must define the same semantic color roles, including every product's brand roles.

product.description: Product brand, typefaces and shape. Contexts only re-point existing roles, so every product inherits everything it does not override. The patient app and the provider workspace share one brand family.

density.description: Spacing and control size, including button padding. Independent of theme and product.
